svg.title: All sixteen entries of each tensor, all sixteen individual stencil derivatives, and all four diver- gences are extracted on the same filter. Explicitly these are the origin functions Jb ij(0), elmi Jb ij(0), and P i elmi Jb ij(0), for b = ∅, sh, sc.
